summary: Maase Inc. (MAAS), a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Sale and Purchase Agreement to sell a 49% equity interest in its Chinese subsidiary, Qingdao Huiju Laixi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., to Galaxicore Holdings Limited for $17 million cash. Consideration is payable 20% prepaid, 50% at closing, and 30% within 30 days post-closing. Expected close by end of August 2026, subject to customary conditions. The divestiture aims to refocus on the AI sector. No premium or advisor named. Monitor closing conditions and installment payments for risk-arb.
